A requested rate is not an output measurement. The USB clock readout requires active playback and a verified direct path; it describes the app transport, not an external measurement of the DAC.
Rates come from Android and USB descriptors. They are not proof that every rate, precision and channel combination works. An unreported rate does not mean it is unsupported.
The decoder reports %1$s → %2$s. The decoded rate differs from the source; this alone does not identify the final DAC clock.
Playback has failed. Open diagnostics for the current error; check source access or reconnect the DAC according to the error.
Connect a USB DAC to inspect its capabilities. The current route has no verified USB direct output; ordinary playback remains available.
The current output is Bluetooth. Its codec is shown in diagnostics; source resolution does not verify a USB direct path. Connect a USB DAC to check direct output.
Confirm the Android USB access dialog, then start playback to check the actual output.
USB access is not granted. In Settings → Playback, enable USB exclusive output and confirm access. If no dialog appears, reconnect the DAC.
The DAC is connected, but exclusive output is off. Enable USB exclusive output in Settings → Playback if you want to bypass the system mixer.
Start or resume a track to check active output. Paused, buffering and previous output facts do not verify the current direct path.
The exclusive path is unavailable or reported an error. Open diagnostics for the USB error, reconnect the DAC, or run the USB driver test in Settings → Playback.
Exclusive output is enabled, but no active USB stream is reported. Check USB diagnostics; the switch alone does not verify takeover.
The strict path cannot preserve this source. Try a supported local lossless PCM track; use ordinary playback for this source when direct output is unavailable.
The DAC or strict decoder cannot accept this format. Compare source precision with the reported USB capabilities and try a supported track; increasing the requested rate will not resolve this.
The output clock could not be verified. Open USB diagnostics and reconnect the DAC. A matching requested rate is not enough to claim direct output.
Digital volume changed the samples. Check the volume warning in diagnostics and use the DAC volume control when available; protect your listening level before changing gain.
Active USB streaming and the strict decoder report a direct path. ECHO processing is bypassed in this mode; use the DAC volume control when available.
The exclusive path is active; Bit-perfect mode is off. Sound processing may be used. To preserve samples, enable USB Bit-perfect in Settings → Playback; it bypasses ECHO sound processing.
Bit-perfect is enabled, but the strict path has not reported direct output. Wait for playback to settle and inspect diagnostics if this persists.
